title: Cloud bank billows

source.source_title: Top Of The Cloud - Time Lapse (Wide Screen 16:9)
source.why_this_clip: A wide white cumulus cloud fills the lower half of the frame against blue sky, and its top edge billows as lobes swell and shift in time-lapse. The clip has no cuts; this interval has the strongest change in the cloud's outline, with a lobe rising on the left and the right side lifting.

source_selection.evidence: Builder inspected16raw source samples spanning the retained interval and boundary margins in preflight-source.jpg. One continuous event; no internal cut/dissolve observed.
